name: Ear Gym
shortDescription: Train your musical ear by naming the interval between two notes. Practice freely across three difficulty tiers or run a 10-round streak-scored challenge — every answer reveals a famous song mnemonic and a piano showing the notes you heard.

generation.notes: Freely chosen concept: no approved GitHub issues; the script's Supabase vote pass failed on Node 20 (no native WebSocket), so manual fallback selection was used per the pipeline prompt. Education chosen as the largest category gap (2/88 apps); no existing music or ear-training app, avoiding the saturated 'arcade' tag. Inspired by Tonedear/Teoria interval quizzes, Functional Ear Trainer's progressive difficulty, and Duolingo streaks. Unique angle: each answer reveals the standard song mnemonic (e.g. Perfect 5th = Star Wars theme) plus a two-octave piano highlighting the played notes. Assumption: intervals always play ascending (melodic or harmonic) so the mnemonics stay accurate; descending mode rejected because mnemonics differ per direction. Challenge scoring: 100 per correct + 20 x (streak - 1) bonus, 10 rounds, max 1900 (maxScore). Audio synthesized with Web Audio triangle-wave oscillators — no assets, no libraries, AudioContext unlocked on first tap for iOS.
